source.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse title sequence

rationale: Mixed-media title design deliberately fuses 3D scenes with halftone, spray paint, offset print, hand drawing, scanned illustrations, and typographic treatment.
notes: The process interview documents scanned physical drawings composited onto 3D-derived sequences and a workflow using Adobe tools plus Cinema 4D. The key bank value is the transformation of material/print grammar into motion, not the software list itself.

decision.rationale: Provides an unusually clear cross-media bridge from comic/print materiality to animated 3D composition, useful for escaping flat web-style imitation.
